claim.claim: Our model achieves 83% accuracy on held-out visits
claim.split_desc: 75% training and 25% test with a fixed random seed
claim.methods_line: Visits were randomly divided into 75% training and 25% test with a fixed random seed.

hypotheses.text: HIST feature patient_event_rate computed on full df leaks test labels into train features and train labels into test features, inflating accuracy.
hypotheses.predicted_signature: Same row split but HIST from train-only drops accuracy substantially toward majority baseline while claimed stays ~83%

hypotheses.text: Performance comes from same-patient visits in train and test allowing patient-identity memorization via other features, not target leakage.
hypotheses.predicted_signature: Train-only HIST with same visit-level split stays ~83% because patient overlap remains

hypotheses.text: 83% equals majority-class rate; model has no skill beyond predicting the majority class.
hypotheses.predicted_signature: Both claimed and controlled accuracy ~ class prior and dummy/majority classifier matches them

hyp.broken_assumption: Feature engineering is done before splitting without using test labels and visits are i.i.d.; patient_event_rate can be computed from full data without target leakage.
hyp.code_patch:
import train
def controlled_eval(df, seed):
    tr, te = train.split_idx(df, seed)
    tr_df = df.iloc[tr]
    global_mean = tr_df[train.TARGET].mean()
    rate_map = tr_df.groupby(train.PATIENT)[train.TARGET].mean()
    data = df.copy()
    data[train.HIST] = data[train.PATIENT].map(rate_map).fillna(global_mean)
    f = train.feats(data)
    X = data[f].to_numpy()
    y = data[train.TARGET].to_numpy()
    y_pred = train.fit_predict(X[tr], y[tr], X[te], seed)
    return y[te], y_pred
